svg.aria-label: Project 2 of 4: DataSentry (lloydaq/DataSentry). A local-first ML dataset diagnostics tool that detects data quality issues, analyzes potential data leakage, reviews suspicious labels, and generates explainable reports before model training. Stack: Python, FastAPI, Pydantic, pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn.
